prompt: Create a high-fidelity desktop web product interface mockup, landscape 1536x1024, viewed straight on, no device frame, no marketing poster. Product name exactly Bhishma. A personal trading supervision workspace. Put visible small text 'Design concept — sample state'. Use readable Space Grotesk headings and IBM Plex Sans body text; financial numbers in tabular numerals. Standard accessible web navigation, buttons, selects, tabs and tables. Left navigation: Workspace, Markets, Portfolio, Research, Journal, Settings. Header: Paper mode, 2 observed sessions, 1 data fault. First task: understand what fourteen specialists are actually doing, their evidence and handoffs, while positions and faults remain visible. A session selector shows 'NU · Stocks · opening arguments'. Evidence text 'Price $15.38 · observed 13:07:40 EDT', 'Forecast return −1.89% · uncalibrated', 'Fundamentals unavailable'. A visible issue says 'Provider response invalid — no vote recorded'. Decision state 'Awaiting coordinator'; 'A recommendation is not a fill'. Standard action 'Request research only'; no buy or sell activation button. Account context 'Sample paper equity $25,000 · 0 open positions'. Fourteen roles: Technician, Newshound, Sentiment, Fundamental, Risk Manager, Trend Prophet, Volume, Whale Watcher, Macro, Devil’s Advocate, Elliott Wave, Options Flow, Arbitrageur, Quant Forecaster. Show running, waiting, and provider-error states clearly in words, no fake percentage progress. Restrained realistic product density, clear hierarchy, minimum readable small type. No Apex, no AI/artificial-intelligence wording, no decorative weapons, holographic gauges, fake charts, earnings promises or neon cyberpunk ornament. World expression is only typography, palette, density and one bounded signature diagram; real tasks and conventional controls organize the screen. Direction: Rainlight Commons. A strategic team working in a contemporary civic atrium after rain, conveyed through a smoked deep jade glass shell #102B2D, pale stone reading surfaces #E9F0EC, restrained jade #25836D and bronze #AE8A51. One signature: a bounded central office/campus responsibility diagram with fourteen labeled stations connected only by the selected review's observed handoff path. Subtle spatial depth and translucent architectural planes make the shared-workspace idea tangible; do not turn the whole interface into a literal city or hide the readable roster. Main workspace center, readable selected-specialist evidence inspector right, persistent faults/positions footer. This should feel unexpectedly sophisticated and calm, with beautiful material light and exact alignment, beyond a grid of equal cards.
